summary: Implemented two narrow slices. Session: versioned per-role sessionStorage (token/scope/finite expiry from login start/API-base), restore only via authenticated rooms read + additive server scope match, no role/audience borrowing, local expiry/focus/pre-dispatch blocking, 401 scoped invalidation vs 403 preservation vs 5xx manual Retry, local-only sign-out with best-effort remove/tombstone and explicit limitation, generation guards for old completions, sign-out controls, storage exception handling, Add pending/10s/uncertain check-before-retry. Diagnostics: default-OFF PERF_DIAGNOSTICS server headers (opaque ID, route template/method/status, request duration, named db_* call-await steps) with CORS expose allowlist and no secrets; default-OFF client VITE_PERF_DIAGNOSTICS bounded in-memory events. Focused local tests 72 pass/0 fail/0 skip plus typecheck/build 0; no actual action timing sample collected, so latency attribution UNKNOWN/NOT RUN and no speedup/root-cause claim. Many actor/race/a11y cases listed NOT RUN; production/cloud/load/browser not run.
